# Local renderer extension

Baseline: crates.io `tui-markdown` 0.3.12, upstream commit
`60ca93207130d20b8c9ab8bb88b0ec0aec8e0f0f` (`tui-markdown` subdirectory).
The upstream workspace's MIT and Apache license texts are included unchanged.

The additive `from_str_with_links` API produces compact labels plus explicit
destination/span attribution. Existing rendering APIs retain their appended
destinations. Table wrapping carries attribution through graphemes and combines
spans only when both styles and link identities match. No escape sequences or
terminal output are generated by this library. Agent Bridge validates targets.

Final attribution is capped at 16,384 spans; overflow clears the map and records a
sticky `metadata_limited` flag. Text/layout is unchanged. This bounds attribution
metadata, not existing text/table intermediate allocations. Destinations use a
borrowed lookup before allocating a new key, avoiding repeated URI-sized copies
for reference links. The manifest/lock select the companion patched core crate.

Local source changes: `src/links.rs`, `src/lib.rs`, `src/renderer/mod.rs`,
`src/renderer/link.rs`, `src/renderer/table.rs`. Other upstream source is retained
without formatting changes. Focused application regressions exercise the public
API; the upstream library tests also run through its locked manifest.
